summary: Plumas County lookout built 1926 and staffed into the 1930s and 1946; listed as gone with removal date unknown, and no source describes the site today.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan 4AR on an enclosed timber tower
facts.status_note: Listed as gone; the register gives no removal date and no source describes the site today

Fire less than two miles south of the station, found by an army pilot and held to about eight acres by a logging crew (Portola Reporter, July 1946)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1929 item places the station about 12 miles west of La Porte and the 1932 item near Cascade. The story reports both readings and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Current condition and access are unknown; no source describes the site today. Gone status comes from the Forest Fire Lookout Association list; the register itself says only that removal is unknown. A personal GitHub note (firewatch-obsidian) says the station was constructed in 1994 at 5717 ft; it contradicts the 1926 register and the 1929 newspaper, so it is not used. Newspaper text is from a transcription site, not the original papers. The 1963 photo credit is Ruby Ford; no image URL was captured, so no photo entry.
